verdict.rationale: Atlas's own docs show online formation of a Delaware C corp in two business days, plus incorporation documents in the Dashboard built from Cooley templates, founder equity issuance, the EIN and the 83(b) filing. Community users confirm a smooth, checklist-driven online process. However, bylaws and initial board approvals are never named explicitly; they are only implied by "incorporation documents" and the Cooley templates. One user also notes that some state/city legwork remains outside Atlas. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bylaws and initial board consents being generated and executed online, and independent confirmation of the full Delaware C corp flow end-to-end.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals

citations.quote: Stripe Atlas incorporates your startup and gives you everything you need to open a bank account, accept payments, and fundraise in two business days.
With Stripe Atlas, you can incorporate a Delaware C corporation (C corp), a Delaware Limited Liability Company (LLC), or a subsidiary
After you form your company, you can view your incorporation documents in the Documents tab of your Atlas Dashboard.
Atlas helps you set up a company using templates created in collaboration with Cooley LLP.
gets your company tax ID (EIN) from the IRS, issues founders equity, and files your 83(b) election
